parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human hepatocyte growth factor receptor (CHEMBL3717). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce presence of canonical SMILES. Join docs to enforce presence of PubMed ID or DOI. Join compound_records to retrieve compound_key. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Filter by target CHEMBL3717 and standard_type IC50. Require non-null canonical_smiles and non-null pubmed_id_or_doi. Do not deduplicate; keep all qualifying activity rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
